text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ROMANIA LIBERA

- The National Oil Company suggested a rise in the price of petrol -- after higher prices of oil in the international market and a depreciated leu currency -- which the Competition Office is to approve. If it does, the price of Premium petrol at refinery gates will be 1,000 lei per litre.
- Trade unions in the Rom Telecom RA accept the privatisation of the telephone company, but say it would follow a programme of reconversion of the staff.
- The Romanian Development Agency approved the creation of the 40th bank in Romania. Raiffeisenbank Romania SA groups several Austrian companies and will have a capital of $11.2 million.
ADEVARUL

- Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said on Monday his cabinet planned to take tough measures to avoid the "Bulgarisation" of the economy. He said ministries and the National Bank were working on a tangible programme which will be presented to the International Monetary Fund after the winter holidays.
- The rise in petrol prices will trigger a 30 percent increase in transport tariffs, said the president of the national road transport union.
- The Tarom SA state-run airline acquired two ATR 42-300 aircraft under a leasing contract from the international consortium Aero International Regional.
LIBERTATEA
- Construction work at Cernavoda nuclear power plant stagnate due to lack of financing.
- Germany's Krupp GFT KFHG.F won a tender to supply the Romanian railway company SNCFR with 20,000 tonnes of railway tracks.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- Leftist Peruvian rebels freed Romanian charge d'affaires Octavian Filip together with other 225 diplomats taken hostage in Lima last week.
ADEVARUL
- Police arrested eight Romanians for trying to cross illegally the border with Hungary.
- General Dorin Gheorghiu, the head of the Romanian fourth army admitted that the army used firearms against the population in the city of Cluj during the 1989 revolt .
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- Metro trade unions threatened to launch over pay and better working conditions.
- National Peasant Party secretary general Radu Vasile said the government would continue to subsidise electricity prices for household consumption.
- The government appointed 17 of the country's 43 local prefects.
- A DASH-8 aircraft of the DAC-AIR private Romanian airline was forced to land on Oradea airport due to damage to one of its engineswhile on its regular flight from Bucharest to Cluj.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- Romania's former king Michael said in a Christmas address that he expected to return to his country soon. ($ =3,914 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
